The '''Independent Company of Settlers''' was a corporation formed out of loyalists of the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who wanted to live in peace from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was made up of about 3,000 people, who were mainly former officers in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], who had grown tired of the constant political posturing within the Empire. It was lead by [[President/Legends|President]] [[Natasi Daala]] and her second-in-command [[Yelnor]].

After her initial 'retirement' from Imperial Starfleet, former [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Daala had a fleet of ships and flew from world-to-world, in search of somewhere to live where they could stay loyal to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and not become part of the New Republic. Eventually, they made a deal with [[K'iin]] to live on the planet [[Pedducis Chorios]]. However, the planet was infected with the [[Death Seed]] plague and the colonists had to defend themselves when the New Republic entered the system to deal with it.
